items.text:
**Before we begin**

In order: the basics of who you are; your time and your living situation; your hard limits — placed early, so everything after them respects them; what you watch and what actually pulls you; the parts of this that bite you back; what you're into, in two passes; where you've been and where this could go; safety; the stakes I run you on; and finally how I should run you. Answer honestly, skip what you must — almost everything can be revised in chat once we know each other.

**How I should run you**

Last stretch. Depending on the role and personality you picked for me.

items.prompt: Anything else I should know before I begin?

items.text:
**What happens next**

Our first chats are calibration. I run you through small experiments — sample tasks, short audio, a taste of trance — one at a time, never more than four in a sitting, a pause in between. After each one I ask how it landed, and your reactions decide what I keep, sharpen, or drop. Everything is announced before it starts, and one word from you ends any of it. The playbook for this lives in `docs/onboarding/experiments.md`.
